clue.text: Break ranks to have an argument

definitions.meaning: soldiers leaving their line on parade do this
to quarrel with someone

explanation.surface: A soldier quits the line to pick a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers who leave formation do this, and friends who quarrel are said to do the same.

clue.text: Always on the side of the angels

definitions.meaning: permanently, for ever

definitions.text: on the side of the angels
definitions.meaning: working for the benefit of others

explanation.surface: Someone is permanently virtuous.
explanation.definitionFit: Permanently is one sense; the other is acting beneficially, for the benefit of others.

clue.text: A match for Old Harry

definitions.meaning: an old name for a friction match
a nickname for the Devil

explanation.surface: Someone is an equal opponent for a man called Harry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Harry' is a British nickname for Satan.
explanation.definitionFit: Early friction matches were sold under this name, which is also Satan's.

clue.text: Better barbecue party

definitions.meaning: to surpass
split as two words, a do held out of doors

explanation.surface: An improved outdoor cookout.
explanation.definitionFit: To surpass is one sense; split in two it is a party held outside, like a barbecue.

clue.text: Use circumlocutions to win someone over

definitions.meaning: to speak around a subject without addressing it
to persuade by discussion

explanation.surface: A persuader speaks evasively to bring a person round.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid a subject while speaking is one sense; to persuade by argument is the other.

clue.text: Be critical, even when in only temporary ill health

definitions.meaning: to disparage or speak badly of
tired and below par for a while

explanation.surface: Someone stays critical of others even while briefly unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: To disparage someone is one sense; the other describes a person exhausted and feeling poorly for a spell.

clue.text: Polish French article needing Russian currency

parts.note: to polish is to rub
le is the French for the

explanation.surface: Someone shines a French object to pay in Russian money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' is not the nationality but the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The monetary unit of Russia, also spelt rouble.

clue.text: Uneasy when away

definitions.meaning: uncomfortable, ill at ease
out, not in the house

explanation.surface: Someone feels uncomfortable when travelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ill at ease is one sense; being out of the house is the other.

clue.text: Letters for mailing to a frontier station

definitions.meaning: outgoing mail, split as two words
a remote military settlement

explanation.surface: Mail is sent to a border garrison.
explanation.definitionFit: Split in two it means outgoing mail; whole, a remote settlement on a border.

clue.text: Drugged toff perpetually blackmailed

parts.note: nob is slang for an upper-class person
a blackmail victim is bled dry of money

explanation.surface: A drugged aristocrat is endlessly extorted.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'nobble' a racehorse is to drug it to stop it winning.
explanation.definitionFit: Racehorses tampered with by dosing are said to be nobbled.

clue.text: Organised cartel with one heartening performance

indicators.note: read as putting something into the heart of another word
the letters of cartel are organised into a new order

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A business cartel stages an uplifting show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organised' rearranges CARTEL into RECTAL, and 'heartening' puts I (one) into its heart.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a musical or poetry performance given to an audience.

clue.text: Order stout vessel-if you want a big wash

definitions.text: vessel-if you want a big wash

parts.note: the Order of the Bath is a British order of chivalry
a tub is a fat, stout person

explanation.surface: Someone wanting a thorough wash orders a sturdy container.
explanation.walkthrough: The Order of the Bath is a British honour; 'tub' is slang for a stout person.
explanation.definitionFit: A large tub filled with water is the receptacle people sit in to wash thoroughly.

clue.text: Sort of betting needed if you are not on the right track

definitions.meaning: wagering placed away from the racecourse, at a bookmaker's shop
having strayed from the intended route

explanation.surface: A gambler is advised on the kind of bet to make when going astray.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain, bets placed in high-street bookmakers rather than at the racetrack are called by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is wagering away from the racetrack; the other is having strayed from a planned route.

clue.text: Cruise spirit in Scandinavia

definitions.meaning: to wander or fish by trailing a line from a moving boat
a supernatural giant or dwarf of Norse folklore

explanation.surface: A holidaymaker takes a cruise to find the spirit of Scandinavia.
explanation.definitionFit: To trail a fishing line from a slowly moving boat is one sense; the other is a creature of Norse folklore.

clue.text: Back yard encompassing alternative style of architecture

indicators.note: one piece surrounds another, so it goes round the outside
placed before the word yard, it turns that piece backwards

parts.note: Scotland Yard is home to the CID, the Criminal Investigation Department
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A garden behind a house enclosing a different architectural style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns CID (Scotland Yard's detectives) into DIC, and 'encompassing' puts OR inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Doric is one of the classical orders of Greek columns, the plainest.

clue.text: Put barrier around electric flex and switch markings

parts.note: a cord is an insulated electric cable
on and off are labelled on a switch

explanation.surface: An electrician fences off cabling and labels the switches.
explanation.definitionFit: Police seal off an area by surrounding it with a line of tape or people.

clue.text: Not carried-out of the orphanage?

parts.note: a motion not carried was rejected; the question mark plays on a child who has not left the orphanage with new parents

explanation.surface: A rejected motion and a child still waiting in the orphanage.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposal not accepted is described this way, as is a child no family has taken in.

clue.text: Matinee is arranged for social conveniences

indicators.note: the letters of Matinee is are arranged in a fresh order

explanation.surface: An afternoon show is laid on for community facilities.
explanation.definitionFit: Useful facilities like parks, shops and libraries.

clue.text: High quality paper used for reproducing records

definitions.meaning: thick drawing paper favoured by artists
the stylus unit on a record player's arm

explanation.surface: Fine paper is used when copying documents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Records' means vinyl discs, not documents: the pick-up head of a turntable reproduces their sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Thick drawing paper bears this name, as does the pick-up head on a gramophone arm.

clue.text: Laid off staff but apparently used cat o' nine tails

definitions.meaning: reduced the workforce
lashed someone on the shoulders

explanation.surface: Staff are dismissed, but it seems a whip was used.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the phrase suggests lashing someone's back with the whip; 'apparently' signals that comic reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Reducing spending or staff is one sense; literally lashing the shoulders with a whip is the other.

clue.text: In anger a politician might go on one

definitions.text: In anger a politician might go on one

parts.words: In anger a politician might go on one
parts.note: a furious person goes on a violent spree; a politician might literally go on a leaf of a parliamentary record

explanation.surface: An angry politician might lose his temper.
explanation.definitionFit: A violent, uncontrolled spree, the sort of thing people go on in anger.

clue.text: Send editor part that is complete

indicators.note: only part of the words Send editor is used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: An editor is sent a finished section of copy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something finished and over is complete.

clue.text: Doctor should diagnose cause of dehydration

parts.note: ought means should

explanation.surface: A doctor diagnoses why a patient is dehydrated.
explanation.definitionFit: A long dry spell without rain parches land and leaves people dehydrated.

clue.text: Named but not in a legal document

indicators.note: one piece is placed within another

parts.note: a deed is a signed legal document
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone named, but missing from a legal paper.
explanation.definitionFit: To denote is to indicate or name.

clue.text: Time to include representative in Strasbourg

indicators.note: the word to takes the other pieces into its middle

parts.note: taken as written
Strasbourg houses the European Parliament, so E for European
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative

explanation.surface: It's time to bring in a member of the European Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'include' puts E (European, for Strasbourg's parliament) plus MP inside TO.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, the speed of a piece is its time or pace.

clue.text: Lower price to import duvet filling

parts.note: to bring goods into a country
down is the soft feathers stuffing a duvet

explanation.surface: Bringing in duvet stuffing cheaply cuts the cost.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce or cut a price is a phrasal verb of lowering.

clue.text: Brother is in France-in Brittany actually

parts.note: est is French for is

explanation.surface: A brother is in France, in Brittany in fact.
explanation.definitionFit: Brest is a port city located in Brittany, in north-western France.

clue.text: A sudden blow adding nothing to enthusiasm

parts.note: a gust is a sudden blast of wind
O resembles zero

explanation.surface: A sudden wind adds nothing to someone's zeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto means relish or keen enjoyment.

clue.text: Shell fish for solitary sailor

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman
alone means by oneself

explanation.surface: A lone yachtsman eats seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: A large edible sea mollusc with an ear-shaped shell lined with mother-of-pearl.

clue.text: Understanding the goal is not far off

definitions.meaning: perception or grasp of a matter

definitions.text: the goal is not far off
definitions.meaning: visible, near at hand

explanation.surface: With comprehension, the target seems close.
explanation.walkthrough: Split into two words, the answer says the goal is visible.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep perception is one sense; split as two words it means visible and close.

clue.text: Exercise resulting in castle seizure

parts.note: a keep is the central tower of a castle
a fit is a seizure or attack

explanation.surface: A workout leads to an attack in a fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: Physical training to stay in shape, such as aerobics.

clue.text: Dashed codes to decipher

indicators.note: to decipher codes is to unscramble them, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Codebreakers rushed to crack the cipher.
explanation.definitionFit: Dashed means rushed or sped off quickly.
